  • Research project · 2023 – 2026

    Smart Pole Interaction Unit (SPIU)

    The Smart Pole Interaction Unit is what my PhD is built around. It stands at the curb, watches the crossing, and tells people on foot when it is their turn, so each car does not have to.

  • Research project · 2026

    Colored Shared Spaces (CSS)

    A two-stage study (N=224) showing how colored ground patterns shape visibility, safety, trust, and confidence in pedestrian–AV shared spaces—and why visual appeal must not compromise legibility.

    • shared spaces
    • visual design
    • pedestrian experience
    • trust

    1 paper

  • Research project · 2026

    VLM Personas for Embodied Studies

    Compares real pedestrians with VLM personas during autonomous-vehicle encounters, showing where simulated personas can support early embodied-study design—and where human participants remain essential.

    • VLM
    • personas
    • field studies
    • autonomous vehicles

  • Research project · 2026

    EmbodiedMind

    A Minecraft agent that plans with a language model, sees with a vision-language model (VLM), and remembers past episodes. It runs on MineDojo.
